content:
A pine.
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ8.

photos.alt: A photo of a lone pine standing on an edge of a hill. There are many big pinecones visible on the branches. A thin footpath goes near the pine, surrounded by grass, ferns, and bushes. Behind the pine, another, smaller pine can be visible below, and some power lines going from left to right. Further, there are hills and the ocean, with a clear blue sky above.
